title: Comunicado 2025-09-25
summary: Banxico cut the policy rate 25bp to 7.50% by a 4-1 majority, with Heath again dissenting for a hold at 7.75%, and said it 'juzgó apropiado continuar con el ciclo de disminuciones', keeping the guidance that it 'valorará recortes adicionales'. The cut is justified by peso behavior, weak activity with important downside risks and trade-policy uncertainty, plus the degree of restriction already in place; the Fed's 25bp cut and a weaker dollar provide external room. The counterweight is unchanged: core is stuck around 4.26%, its forecast was revised up and the risk balance is still tilted up (though less than in 2021-2024), with convergence still expected in Q3 2026. Versus the August communique the message is essentially a continuation -- same 25bp pace, same open-ended easing guidance, same split -- so the read is a cut with further easing as the base case, trimmed by Heath's persistent dissent.

key_quotes.quote: La Junta de Gobierno juzgó apropiado continuar con el ciclo de disminuciones de la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: The Board frames the move as continuation of the easing cycle

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno valorará recortes adicionales a la tasa de referencia.
key_quotes.context: Guidance unchanged from August: further cuts to be weighed

key_quotes.quote: Se considera que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza, si bien este es menos pronunciado que el enfrentado entre 2021 y 2024.
key_quotes.context: Upside-tilted but softened risk balance; core forecast nudged up

key_quotes.quote: Votó a favor de mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en un nivel de 7.75% Jonathan Heath.
